flipToBack.timing: RequiredGameTextTriggerAction (singleton) on TriggerConditions.isTableChanged; auto-fires whenever condition holds. OPPONENT-DRIVEN: fires when opponent's Dark Jedi shows up.
flipToBack.prose: Flip if an opponent's Dark Jedi is PRESENT at an interior Naboo battleground site (presentAt = actual presence at the site, spotting includes excluded-from-battle).

flipToFront.timing: RequiredGameTextTriggerAction (singleton) on TriggerConditions.isTableChanged; auto-fires whenever condition holds. Flip is accompanied by retrieve 1 Force.
flipToFront.prose: Back flips to front (and owner retrieves 1 Force) if opponent has NO Dark Jedi present at any interior Naboo battleground site - exact negation of the front flip spot.

requirementSemantics: Flip trigger both ways is OPPONENT PRESENCE (Filters.presentAt), not control and not occupy: a single opponent Dark Jedi present at an interior Naboo battleground site flips front->back; zero such Dark Jedi flips back->front (+1 Force retrieval).
The objective's own side never flips it forward by board development; it toggles purely on opponent's Dark Jedi positioning. Both spots use SpotOverride.INCLUDE_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE.
Back->front retrieval: FlipCardEffect followed by RetrieveForceEffect(playerId, 1) in the same required action. Card13_046_BACK.java:189-193
typedIdentities: Filters.and(Filters.your(self), Filters.Jedi) - front drain-protection + targeting enabler; back drain/battle self-ban scope

otherObligations: Front: opponent may not Force drain at same location as opponent's Dark Jedi. Card13_046.java:87

missingStateCalculation: The front flip-progress rule is deliberately opponent-driven. It reports the source condition but never masquerades as a route that the owner can complete by deploying or moving a Jedi.

The front payoff is executable only during the owner's control phase at an interior Theed Palace site where the exact target survives both current game-text narrowing modifications and TargetingReason.TO_BE_LOST.

The back payoff is executable only during the owner's move phase. It may occur at any location, not merely the interior Naboo battleground keeping the objective flipped, and both duelists must be legal objective targets.
flipPreservation: A typed Jedi deploy parent beats generic deployment and Pass when the candidate has a direct legal deploy to a front target-loss pairing or a back lightsaber-combat pairing. A stranded active Jedi no longer suppresses a useful hand copy; the exception closes once an active Jedi has an executable pairing.

Destination scoring sends the Jedi to the exact legal opponent location. Movement starts a safe route, rewards the exact destination, and holds an already executable pairing; Formation Safety's doomed-solo veto remains dominant.

Standalone and combined battle Force-loss selection retain exactly the first typed Jedi in hand while no active Jedi is on table. Once a typed Jedi is active, ordinary duplicate and loss priorities resume.
The exact front Target character action and back Initiate lightsaber combat action beat Pass and ordinary same-phase alternatives only when their source objective, face, and action text all match.
runtimeOwners: ObjectiveAnalyzer owns family identity, exact setup hydration, opponent-driven flip state, phase-windowed payoff state, source-modified target legality, deploy feasibility, stranded-copy recovery, and Force-loss retention facts.

NabooDuelObjectivePolicy owns the bounded exact-action scores and front deploy-destination score. MoveDestinationPolicy owns safe start, exact destination, and established-pair retention contributions.
Mirrored Rando and Chosen One ActionTextEvaluator, CardSelectionEvaluator, DeployEvaluator, and MoveEvaluator adapters consume the same shared facts and policies.
contradictions: The owner cannot force the objective to flip by staging a Jedi. Only an opponent Dark Jedi at the source-defined gate causes the front flip.

The front target-loss site is any interior Theed Palace site with a legal opponent character. It is not limited to the specific interior Naboo battleground where an opponent Dark Jedi caused the flip.
The back lightsaber combat may occur at any location. Restricting it to an interior Naboo battleground would silently discard legal source actions.
13_24 Inner Strength is an Epic Event. Its storage in startingEffects is a legacy data-bucket convention, not a card-type claim.
